name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's passion for motorsport ignited early, fuelled by watching Kiwi legends dominate the circuits. He pursued a degree in Communications, focusing on public relations, with the aim of bridging the gap between teams and their fans. His entry into the world of racing began with an internship at a local racing team, where he honed his skills in crafting compelling narratives and managing media relations. 

Liam is dedicated to building strong relationships with journalists, sponsors, and fans alike. He believes in transparent communication and is adept at crafting engaging content across multiple platforms. His approach is hands-on, always ready to immerse himself in the details of a project and go the extra mile to ensure its success. Liam's loyalty and commitment make him a valuable asset to any team looking to enhance their public image.

What sets Liam apart is his deep understanding of the New Zealand motorsport culture and his ability to connect with the unique fanbase. He's not just a PR officer; he's a storyteller who brings the passion and spirit of racing to life.

physical.description: Liam is of average height with a friendly, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of coffee throughout the day.
